Workers AI adds Gemma 3 4B

Cloudflare announced on 2026-04-10 that Gemma 3 4B is now available on Workers AI, accessible via the @cf/google/gemma-3-4b binding. Latency at the 95th percentile is reported at 420 ms for a 512-token completion.

The model is tuned for instruction-following and tool use. It joins Gemma 2 9B and a handful of Llama variants in the Workers AI catalog.

Pricing follows the standard Workers AI neuron model; the first 10,000 neurons per day remain free.
